cases.title: Dear Mom
cases.text: Tribal mothers speaking straight to other mothers, so families trust WIC enough to enroll.
cases.story: The Inter Tribal Council of Arizona's WIC program had eligible families who weren't enrolling. Our SITREP found the barrier was trust, not awareness, so we put tribal mothers on camera talking straight to other mothers: no narration, no institutional voice, shot in unbroken takes so they read as neighbors.

cases.title: Vaccine education
cases.text: Vaccine education told by tribal health leaders in their own words, not by outside authorities.
cases.story: ITCA's Tribal Epidemiology Center needed vaccine education for communities with good reason to distrust government health campaigns. Standard messaging had backfired, so the research pointed us to tribal health leaders and community members telling it in their own words. This breakdown walks through every choice we made.
